skills: Understanding Git History**: The student should learn how to verify
and reconcile historical data with the current state of a repository.
Conflict Resolution**: The student should learn how to handle and
resolve contradictions between historical and current data, using the rule
of prioritizing the current state.
Commit History Analysis**: The student should learn how to analyze the
commit history to understand the sequence of changes and the relationships
between different versions of the repository.

transitions and ensure they are idempotent and rollable back.

the system can recover from failures.
Concurrency Control**: Understanding how to handle concurrent
operations and ensure the system remains consistent.
